assumptions: SPEC-072 emits a winner with candidate text, evaluation and cost report digests compatible with harness_promotion.decide(); skill texts fit the scope map limits; runtime stays standard-library only.
compatibility: Additive: profile registry and experience store formats unchanged; the build check applies only to scopes with a registry, so existing builds are unchanged until a promotion is committed.
domain: Braid Lightning promotion of optimized skill and prompt texts through the HAR profile registry (cohort native) into the packaged Agent Braid plugin.
execution_contract: executionAuthorization stays false; AUTOMATIC_PROMOTION stays False; writes only to the registry file, the Lightning run store and the mapped SKILL.md after a human decision and a matching preview digest; no release or publication without the owner's explicit yes.
hypotheses: None; engineering specification with no scientific claim.
observation_contract: Registry journal entries (record, decision, begin, commit, abort, rollback, revoke) with digests; preview documents with previewDigest; build check results naming scope and digests; owner promotion evidence with command, hashes and outcome.

scenarios.given: a stored BL.2 winner for scope lightning.skill.analyze
scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound procedure record: command, hashes, environment, expected and actual outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: a native record with the winner's candidateSha256 is returned; an unknown scope, a tampered text and an oversize text are each refused with a named reason

requirements.text: Candidate record. lightning_promote.build_record turns a BL.2 winner into a valid ProfileRegistry.record input with cohort native and candidateSha256; unknown scope, digest mismatch with stored text, or oversize text is refused.

scenarios.given: a recorded native candidate and its evaluation
scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound procedure record: command, hashes, environment, expected and actual outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: the human path journals decision, begin and commit; the automatic actor, a synthetic cohort and a stale identity are refused
scenarios.when: apply runs with a human approved decision, and separately with an automatic actor

requirements.text: Human decision only. decide() runs only with a human actor; an automatic actor is refused with automatic-promotion-disabled; begin and commit run only after an approved decision for the same candidate and current identity.

scenarios.given: a candidate and an unchanged plugin tree
scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound procedure record: command, hashes, environment, expected and actual outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: the preview changes no bytes; apply succeeds; a registry or file change after the preview yields preview-stale
scenarios.when: promote runs without and then with --apply and the printed digest

requirements.text: Preview and apply. lightning promote --candidate prints scope, target path, digests, diff summary, evidence and previewDigest without writing; --apply --preview-digest writes only when digest, registry bytes and file bytes still match; outputs carry executionAuthorization false.

scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound procedure record: command, hashes, environment, expected and actual outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: the first build passes; the second fails with lightning-promotion-mismatch naming scope and both digests
scenarios.when: the plugin is built, then built again after a hand edit of the mapped file

requirements.text: Build check. The plugin build verifies each mapped SKILL.md digest equals the registry's active candidate and names scope, expected and actual digests on mismatch.

scenarios.given: two committed promotions for one scope
scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound procedure record: command, hashes, environment, expected and actual outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: the previous digest is active, the file bytes equal it and the build passes; rollback with no previous yields no-previous

requirements.text: Rollback. promote --rollback --scope previews and applies restoration of the previous active digest and text; the next build carries it.

scenarios.given: an active candidate citing an evaluation digest
scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound procedure record: command, hashes, environment, expected and actual outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: the previous candidate becomes active and the file is restored after apply; revoking uncited evidence changes nothing

requirements.text: Revocation. Revoking evidence cited by the active decision deactivates that candidate and restores the previous one; the file change is previewed before applying.

scenarios.given: three short reflections from a BL.2 run
scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound procedure record: command, hashes, environment, expected and actual outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: three quarantined entries exist; a 513-character text and a poisoned text are refused; no entry is active

requirements.text: Reflections. Optional GEPA reflections are proposed through ExperienceStore.add with poison screening and the 512-character limit and remain quarantined; activate is never called.

scenarios.given: the module under a patched socket, subprocess and filesystem
scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound procedure record: command, hashes, environment, expected and actual outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: no socket or process is opened, no other module is imported and no other path is written

requirements.text: Boundaries. The module opens no socket, launches no process, imports only the standard library and Agent Braid modules, exposes no MCP tool, and writes only the registry, run store and mapped file.

scientific_limits: Engineering only. A promoted candidate's BL.2 score describes a fixed task set, cohort and host versions; promotion does not establish general superiority. Build checks verify bytes, not behaviour.
scope: Specification only: human promotion of a BL.2 winning text as a native ProfileRegistry candidate, a closed scope-to-skill map, a preview/apply CLI, a plugin build check binding shipped SKILL.md to the active candidate, rollback, evidence revocation, and quarantined experience reflections.
